userName.description: A unique identifier for the user and authenticates the user in Webex.  This must be set to the user's primary email address.  No other user in Webex may have the same `userName` value and thus this value is required to be unique within Webex.

title.description: The user's business title.  Examples of a title is "Business Manager". "Senior Accountant", "Engineer" etc.

active.description: A boolean value of "true" or "false" indicating whether the user is allowed to login to Webex.

roles.description: List of roles assigned to the user.

preferredLanguage.description:
User's preferred language.  Acceptable values for this field are based on the [ISO-696](http://www.loc.gov/standards/iso639-2/php/code_list.php) and [ISO-3166](https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#search) with the 2 letter language code followed by an _ and then the 2 letter country code.  Examples are:

                                    en_US : for United States English or fr_FR for Parisian French.

locale.description:
The user's locale which represents the user's currency, time format, and numerical representations.  Acceptable values are based on the [ISO-696](http://www.loc.gov/standards/iso639-2/php/code_list.php) and [ISO-3166](https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#search) with the 2 letter language code followed by an _ and then the 2 letter country code.  Examples are:

                         en_US : for United States English or fr_FR for Parisian French.

timezone.description: The user's time zone specified in the [IANA timezone](https://nodatime.org/timezones) timezone format. e.g: "America/Los_Angeles".

profileUrl.description: A fully qualified URL pointing to a page representing the user's online profile.

externalId.description: User identifier provided by an external provisioning source.

displayName.description: The name displayed for the user in Webex.

nickName.description: A casual name of the user. For example, Bob when the user's formal name is Robert.

type.description: We support the following phone number types: 'mobile', 'work', 'fax', 'work_extension', 'alternate1', 'alternate2'.  Alternate 1 and Alternate 2 are types inherited from Webex meeting sites.

display.description: A human-readable name, primarily used for display purposes.

primary.description: A Boolean value indicating the phone number's primary status.

phoneNumbers.description: A list of user's phone numbers.

photos.description: A list of photo objects for the user.

streetAddress.description: The full street address component, which may include house number, street name, P.O. box, and multi-line extended street address information. This attribute MAY contain newlines.

postalCode.description: The zip code or postal code component.

emails.description: A list of the user's email addresses, including primary and alternative emails. The primary work email address must match the value of the user's username.

employeeNumber.description: Numeric or alphanumeric identifier assigned to a person, typically based on the order of hire or association with an organization.

value.description: Webex Identity assigned user identifier of the user's manager. The manager must belong to the same org as the user.

accountStatus.description: An array of additional information about a user's status.

managedOrgs.description: Organizations that the user can manage.

managedGroups.description: Groups that the user can manage.

extensionAttribute*.description: The extension attributes of the user. Postfix support from 1 to 15, for example: "extensionAttribute1", "extensionAttribute2", ..., "extensionAttribute15".

externalAttribute*.description: The external attributes of the user. Postfix support from 1 to 15, for example: "externalAttribute1", "externalAttribute2", ..., "externalAttribute15".
